attachesAs: a dependent long-u sign that normally ligates with the consonant carrier
compositionOrder: write the Tamil consonant carrier first
add the ū vowel sign to replace its inherent vowel

compositionSource.citation: The Unicode Standard, Version 17.0, §12.6.3 Tamil Ligatures, Ligatures with Vowel u and Table 12-28: U+0BC2 TAMIL VOWEL SIGN UU normally ligates with its consonant; க + ூ → கூ (2025)
compositionSource.variation: Unicode specifies encoded carrier-first composition and rendering that normally ligates; this is not a universal handwriting direction, and the source supports no standalone ductus claim or pen-lift count.
